lemma set_cap_cdt_wp[wp]:
  "\<lbrace>\<lambda>s. P (cdt s)\<rbrace> set_cap cap p \<lbrace>\<lambda>_ s. P (cdt s)\<rbrace>"
  by (wpsimp simp: set_cap_def split_def set_object_def wp: get_object_wp | clarsimp)+
rationale: mdb_set_cap at line 885 already proves (as a monad fact) that set_cap preserves cdt. This adds the canonical Hoare-triple wp form so the frame fires automatically in wp tactic searches.
strengthening_claim: Strictly stronger delivery: converts the existing monad-equality fact into a wp-registered Hoare triple usable directly by the wp tactic.
